entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioners
 Through: Mr. Prashant Borkar, Advocate for all
 the petitioners.

Respondents
 Through: Mr. Sanjay Lao, Standing Counsel for
 the State.

Mr. Bilal Ahmed and Mr. Vineet,
 Advocates for R-2 in person.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing for FIR No. 338/2012 registered at Ghazipur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide settlement dated 03rd September, 2022 arrived at with the facilitation with the Delhi Mediation Centre,
Karkardooma Courts, which is on record of this Court.
Petitioner Nos. 1-4 and respondent No. 2 (complainant) are present in Court and are duly identified by their counsels and the Investigating Officer.

2. It is stated that the husband of respondent No.2 Khajan Singh has passed away on 05th May,
2019, the death certificate is already placed on record.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Consequently, the FIR No. 338/2012 Digitally Signed By:ANISH DAYAL under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Ghazipur and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
4. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
